  • Aurora Arches is a soft, flowing look for anyone who likes colour without too much noise.
  • Black And Colourful Tetris is a fun pick for gamers and anyone who grew up on blocks falling from the top of a screen.

  • Blue Sober is calm and clean when you want something simple.

  • Yellow And Black Magnet – bold and high-contrast, a good match for a phone like the Poco, which already likes a little attitude.
  • Aurora Arches – soft, flowing colour for anyone who wants the back of the phone to feel calm.
  • Black And Colourful Tetris – playful blocks that suit gamers and anyone with a soft spot for retro.
  • Dark Static – a moody, low-key look if you like your phone understated.
  • Iceberg Topography – fine line work that looks like a map; it rewards a closer look.
  • Black Board Doodles – scribbled, sketchbook energy for a more casual feel.
  • Hacking In Progress – a techie pick that gets a smile from friends and colleagues.
  • Blue Sober – a clean, restrained blue for a no-fuss, professional look.

Not sure? Go with what you would be happy to see every time you flip the phone over. A mobile back skin is something you look at all day, so pick the design that matches your mood rather than the one that seems safest.

Your Poco M3 PRO 5G skin comes in three finishes, and the finish changes how the phone looks and feels as much as the design does.

They do different jobs, and plenty of people use both. A skin is a thin vinyl layer that sticks to the back of the phone. It guards against everyday scratches and scuffs, adds very little bulk, and keeps the phone slim enough for your pocket and your usual grip. It is also where the personality comes from, since the design is the whole point.

A case is thicker and covers more of the phone, which is useful if you want a raised edge around the screen or a bulkier feel. The trade-off is size and weight. If you like the phone as it is, only slimmer-looking and better looked after, a skin is the lighter choice. If you want a more padded feel, you can add a case over the skin and still keep your design visible with a clear one.

  • Line it up – peel the skin from its backing slowly and align one edge with the phone before letting the rest down, since it is cut to the Poco M3 PRO 5G outline.
  • Press and smooth – work from the centre outwards with your thumb or a soft card to push out air bubbles.
  • Settle it in – press the edges down firmly and give it a little time before you put the phone in a pocket or bag.

Take your time on the second step, because alignment is what makes a Poco mobile skin look factory-made. If you do trap a bubble, lift the skin gently and lay it down again.

Poco X4 PRO 5G skins, cut to order

If you carry a Poco X4 PRO 5G, there are 317 designs waiting for it on GoSkinly. They run from loud and graphic to calm and quiet, so whether you want your phone to stand out on a café table or just look a bit less plain, you will find something that suits. Every Poco X4 PRO 5G skin here is made for your exact phone, not a generic size that you trim at home.

Here is how it works: you pick the design and finish, place the order and pay online (UPI, cards or netbanking). Only then is your Poco X4 PRO 5G back skin printed and cut for this exact model. Nothing is sitting in a warehouse waiting to be force-fitted. That is why the cut edges line up with the phone's outline, and why the skin sits flat instead of curling at the corners.

Designs people pick for the Poco X4 PRO 5G

With 317 designs, browsing can take a while, so here is a sense of what is on offer. Some people go bold: Yellow And Black Magnet gives the back of the phone a strong, high-contrast look, and Black And Colourful Tetris is a fun pick if you grew up on blocks falling down a screen.

If you like something more atmospheric, Aurora Arches and Iceberg Topography are easy on the eye and look good with or without a case. For the tech crowd, Hacking In Progress and Dark Static lean into that late-night-coding mood. Black Board Doodles has a scribbled, playful feel, and Blue Sober is the one to choose when you want colour without any shouting.

Think about how you hold your phone and where you use it. A busy pattern hides fingerprints and small scuffs well, while a plain tone shows off the finish. There is no wrong answer, and the whole point of a Poco mobile skin is that you can change your mind later without much fuss.

Finishes

Each design can come in the finishes below. Pick the one that matches how you like your phone to feel in the hand.

  • Matte: a smooth, non-glossy surface that gives a soft, understated look and is comfortable to hold.
  • 3D embossed (textured): a raised texture you can feel under your fingers, which adds grip and a bit of character.
  • Transparent: lets the phone's own colour show through, so you keep the original look while adding a layer against everyday wear.

Skin or case?

This is not really an either-or question, but it helps to know what each one does. A case is a thick shell. It adds bulk, and a lot of people like that feeling of padding. A mobile back skin is the opposite: a thin vinyl layer that guards the back against everyday scratches and scuffs, adds very little bulk, and keeps the phone feeling like the phone you bought.

If you like the slim look and mostly want to stop keys, coins and desk surfaces from marking the back, a skin does that job and lets you pick the design you want. If you want a thicker shell for extra cushioning, a case is the better tool, and nothing stops you from using a skin underneath or choosing a case with a clear back.

Another point in favour of skins is removal. A GoSkinly skin comes off without leaving sticky residue, so when you get tired of the design or sell the phone, you peel it off and the back looks clean again. Cases can hide wear, but they do not change how the phone looks. A skin does.

How to apply it

Applying a skin is easier than it sounds. Take your time with it and keep the room free of dust, and you will get a neat result in a few minutes.

  • Clean the back: wipe the phone with a soft, lint-free cloth so there is no dust, oil or fingerprints left.
  • Align one edge: peel back a small section of the skin and line it up with the camera area and one edge of the phone first.
  • Press and smooth: slowly peel the rest while smoothing it down with your fingers or a soft card, pushing any air bubbles toward the edges.
  • Finish the edges: press down the corners and borders firmly, and leave the phone alone for a while so the skin settles.

Free shipping applies across India on orders of ₹500 and above, so you can add more than one design if you cannot decide, or pick one for a friend's phone too.
